title: HTTP/3: Implement Follow HTTP/3 Stream
description:
Add the payload (decoded) of HTTP/3 QPACK encoder and decoder streams,
and HEADERS and DATA frames on bidi streams to Follow HTTP/3 stream.
Also add PRIORITY_UPDATE, translating it into the corresponding
Priority HTTP Header Field is represents.  Other frames seem not as
useful to have, but could be added as desired, e.g. SETTINGS.

Since QUIC multipath isn't supported yet, HTTP/3 session IDs are the
same as QUIC connection IDs, and HTTP/3 stream IDs are the same as
the QUIC stream IDs. Move some of the QUIC follow functions and a type
to the QUIC header for use by HTTP/3.

Fix #20610
